items.name: utils
items.title: cn
items.description: cn() with a tailwind-merge config that knows the control-size spacing keys, plus the Inertia toUrl() helper.

items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: Design tokens of the qiick apps (shared base, teal brand): colours for light, dark and high contrast, AI accent, control-size scale, focus ring, base and reduced-motion rules, and the scroll cue of wide tables.

items.name: theme-blue
items.title: Theme: Blue preset
items.description: Blue brand preset (Excubia): brand-only tokens over the shared base. Import after qiick-theme.css.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Inline alert (shadcn new-york-v4) with the qiick status variants success, warning and info next to default and destructive.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert dialog
items.description: Confirmation dialog (shadcn new-york-v4): size default / sm, AlertDialogMedia, Action and Cancel take Button variant and size; Esc and Cancel never confirm.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Badge (shadcn new-york-v4, incl. ghost / link) plus the qiick status variants muted, success, warning, info, ai; primary hover token.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Breadcrumb primitives.

items.description: Chat bubble with muted, ghost, destructive, … variants.

items.name: button

items.description: Button on the control-size scale (sm 24 / default 32 / lg 40), primary hover token.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Radix checkbox.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Modal dialog with translated close button.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: Radix dropdown menu.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: Empty-state primitives.

items.description: Form field layout: label, control, description, error.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Text input, default control height.

items.name: input-group

items.description: Input or textarea with inline addons and buttons.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Form label.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: Chat message row: avatar, content, footer, aligned start or end.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native select
items.description: Native <select> styled like the Select trigger.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Pagination primitives.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: Radix radio group.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Radix Select; trigger and items on the control scale.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Horizontal or vertical rule.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Side panel built on the dialog primitive (shadcn new-york-v4, showCloseButton) with a translated close button.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Collapsible app sidebar with the straight full-height active bar (externa-core #463).

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Loading placeholder.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: shadcn spinner (Loader2 with role=status) with a translated label.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: One-time code input (shadcn new-york-v4): InputOTP, InputOTPGroup, InputOTPSlot, InputOTPSeparator.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Switch (shadcn new-york-v4), size default / sm.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Range slider (shadcn new-york-v4), one or more thumbs.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Table primitives (shadcn new-york-v4) used by the flat list panels; the container is a keyboard-scrollable region with the scroll cue when the table is wider than its card.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line text input.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: Two-state button on the control scale.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle group
items.description: Segmented control (use variant="outline" with type="single"); spacing > 0 separates the items.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs; variant="line" for the views of one record under the header.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Tooltip (shadcn new-york-v4): foreground background, background text.

items.name: use-mobile
items.title: useIsMobile
items.description: Media-query hook used by the sidebar.

items.name: use-scroll-region
items.title: useScrollRegion
items.description: Puts a scroll container in the tab order (a named region when given a name) while its content overflows, so the keyboard can scroll it, and marks the sides that hide content for the theme's scroll cue (used by Table and TablePanel).

items.name: header-icon-button
items.title: Header icon button
items.description: Icon-only button with a tooltip label, for page headers and toolbars.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page header
items.description: Page description, subheader and filter row, plus FilterSearch.

items.name: page-layout
items.title: Page layout
items.description: Admin page scaffold (description, filter row, body, footer), the flat TablePanel and the list pagination footer with rows per page.

items.name: data-table-toolbar
items.title: Data table toolbar
items.description: Search and bulk-selection toolbar for data tables.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: Server-driven TanStack DataTable (sort, filter and paging done by the server), DataTableColumnHeader (sort dropdown), DataTableFacetedFilter (Popover + Command facet), selection and expand columns; pagination footer from page-layout.

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: Date range picker
items.description: One field for a from–to range on the Calendar (externa-core): two clicks pick the days with a hover preview; withTime adds a start and an end time committed with Apply, min / max bound the days.

items.name: paginated-multi-select
items.title: Paginated multi-select
items.description: Server-searched picker on Popover + Command: debounced search, next page on scroll, Badge chips, user rows with avatar; multiple={false} is the single-select picker.

items.name: removable-badge
items.title: Removable badge
items.description: Removable tag chip: a secondary Badge with a ghost Button size="icon-xs" and its own remove label.

items.name: page-empty-state
items.title: Page empty state
items.description: Empty state: icon, title, one sentence, one CTA, optional docs link.

items.name: settings-form-actions
items.title: Settings form actions
items.description: Sticky Save bar for settings forms.

items.name: confirm-destructive-dialog
items.title: Confirm destructive dialog
items.description: Cancel / Delete confirmation, optionally gated by typing a name.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App shell
items.description: Two-tone shell: sidebar provider, framed inset content panel, header with sidebar trigger, breadcrumbs and actions.

items.name: chat-layout
items.title: Chat layout
items.description: Chat page body as on externa-core /ai and /chat: list column, thread, composer.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Date grid (shadcn new-york-v4 on react-day-picker) with a connected range band, and slot components at module level so a parent's range hover preview does not remount the grid (externa-core date range picker).

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Card surface on the shadcn new-york v4 card: header with optional CardAction, title, description, content and footer (dashboard cards).

items.name: stat-card
items.title: Stat card
items.description: Key number from the shadcn dashboard-01 block (section cards): label, large tabular value, trend badge and a two-line footer. trendOf() builds the badge text.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context menu
items.description: Right-click menu, with the destructive item variant.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: The shadcn avatar, unchanged (sizes, AvatarBadge, AvatarGroup, AvatarGroupCount). Per-user colour comes from `avatarToneClass()` (avatar-tone item) passed to AvatarFallback.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: Side drawer (vaul) with a scrolling body between a fixed header and footer. qiick additions to shadcn: DrawerNested (vaul NestedRoot), DrawerContent showOverlay, focus moved into the drawer on open (never left on the trigger), right-side width max-w-md.

items.name: actions-overflow
items.title: Actions overflow
items.description: Toolbar actions that spill into a ⋯ menu only when space runs out (ResizeObserver), with a pinned slot that never spills.

items.name: user-avatar
items.title: User avatar
items.description: UserAvatar with per-user colour initials and the online / offline presence dot, plus the realtime ConnectionDot.

items.name: user-hover-card
items.title: User hover card
items.description: A user card on hover or focus (HoverCard): avatar, name, role badge, online / offline. Presence comes in as a prop.

items.name: nav-user
items.title: Sidebar user menu
items.description: Sidebar user menu: avatar with the connection dot, name, chevron; dropdown with settings, language, appearance, accessibility and logout.

items.name: files-grid
items.title: Files grid
items.description: Files grid with square file / folder cards: preview above a 40px name row, tag hover card, ⋮ menu with the right-click actions, selection checkbox, infinite scroll with a Load more fallback.

items.name: assistant-panel
items.title: Assistant panel
items.description: Assistant side panel: right drawer with thread and composer, toggled by ⌘J / Ctrl+J and the sidebar Assistant item.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Sonner (toasts)
items.description: The shadcn sonner Toaster for the two toast channels: notifications top-right below the header with status colours, icon and close button; success messages placed top-centre by toast.success().

items.name: toast
items.title: toast
items.description: toast() for the whole app: success as a small top-centre message, error / warning / info as notifications; errors are also announced assertively to screen readers.

items.name: notifications
items.title: Notifications
items.description: Core notification centre: NotificationsBell (sidebar bell with the unread badge, live through an optional subscribe) and NotificationsDrawer (right-side list, mark as read, mark all as read), createNotificationsSource() for the Laravel database notifications contract, SidebarUnreadBadge and the opt-in notification sound.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: Item, ItemGroup, ItemMedia, ItemContent, ItemTitle, ItemDescription, ItemActions: list rows with media, text and actions.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: Command (cmdk): searchable lists with keyboard navigation; Popover + Command is the picker pattern.

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: Message scroller
items.description: Scroll container of a conversation: sticks to the bottom while streaming, keeps the anchor when older messages load.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: File and image attachments in chat messages and composers.

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: Status line in a conversation (typing, tool running, day separator), announced with role=status.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: ChartContainer, ChartTooltip and ChartLegend around recharts, coloured from a ChartConfig.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button group
items.description: ButtonGroup, ButtonGroupSeparator, ButtonGroupText: split buttons and toolbars.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Kbd and KbdGroup for keyboard shortcuts.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll area
items.description: Scroll container with styled scrollbars.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Accordion with single or multiple open items.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover card
items.description: Preview card on hover or focus.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect ratio
items.description: Fixed aspect ratio box for media.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Carousel on Embla, with keyboard and previous / next buttons.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: The shadcn popover (with PopoverHeader, PopoverTitle, PopoverDescription); Popover + Command is the picker pattern.

items.name: shadcn-utilities
items.title: shadcn utilities
items.description: shadcn/tailwind.css (shadcn 4.23.0): data-* variants, scroll-fade, shimmer, no-scrollbar and the accordion keyframes. Import it after tailwindcss in the app CSS.

items.name: avatar-tone
items.title: Avatar tone
items.description: avatarToneClass(id): the theme's avatar-1 … avatar-10 swatch classes for a user id, passed to AvatarFallback (and a sender name) where users must be told apart.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: shadcn collapsible; CollapsibleContent animates open and closed (tw-animate-css collapsible keyframes).

items.name: trace
items.title: Trace
items.description: shadcn Trace (radix-nova source, lucide chevron): lines of agent work with running, error and pending states, collapsible to their detail. The base of the AI Elements.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: shadcn progress bar.

items.name: clipboard
items.title: Clipboard
items.description: copyTextToClipboard() with an execCommand fallback (focus outside the document, insecure context) and readTextFromClipboard().

items.name: ai-message-parts
items.title: AI message parts
items.description: The parts model of an AI answer (reasoning, text, tool, provider tool, sources, usage) and the reducers that build it from the laravel/ai stream events or the stored steps.

items.name: shimmer
items.title: Shimmer
items.description: AI Elements Shimmer: text that shimmers while something runs (needs shadcn-utilities).

items.name: reasoning
items.title: Reasoning
items.description: AI Elements Reasoning on shadcn Trace: "Thinking…" shimmering while it streams, then "Thought for N seconds", collapsed, opening to the text.

items.name: chain-of-thought
items.title: Chain of thought
items.description: AI Elements Chain of Thought on shadcn Trace: a summary line ("Done in 3 steps") that opens to one Tool line per step.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code block
items.description: AI Elements CodeBlock: shiki-highlighted code (light and dark) with a copy button through copyTextToClipboard.

items.name: tool
items.title: Tool
items.description: AI Elements Tool on shadcn Trace: one line with a sentence the app writes for the call, never the raw JSON; a failed call opens to its error.

items.name: suggestion
items.title: Suggestion
items.description: AI Elements Suggestion: outline sm buttons in one sideways-scrolling row, each shrink-0.

items.name: confirmation
items.title: Confirmation
items.description: AI Elements Confirmation on Item: a call waiting for approval, its question and Reject / Approve.

items.name: sources
items.title: Sources
items.description: AI Elements Sources on shadcn Trace: "Used N sources", opening to one link per source.

items.name: context
items.title: Context
items.description: AI Elements Context: token usage of a turn against the model context window, with the input / output / reasoning / cache breakdown in a hover card.

items.name: ai-answer-parts
items.title: AI answer parts
items.description: AiAnswerParts renders the parts of an answer in order on Trace (Reasoning, a Tool line or a Chain of Thought, text through the app renderer), with tool sentences from the app describeToolCall; AiAnswerSources and AiAnswerUsage add Sources and Context.

items.name: chat-message-reactions
items.title: Chat message reactions
items.description: Reactions under a chat bubble on BubbleReactions: one Button xs per emoji with its count, pressed when the viewer reacted, a Tooltip naming who.

items.name: chat-attachment-file
items.title: Chat attachment file
items.description: ChatAttachmentFile (a sent file on Attachment: opens on click, Download plus app menu entries) and ChatPendingFile (uploading, error, remove).

items.name: chat-reply-quote
items.title: Chat reply quote
items.description: The quoted message of a reply on Item (muted, left rule): jumps to the original in a bubble, carries the cancel action above the composer.

items.name: chat-pinned-bar
items.title: Chat pinned bar
items.description: Pinned messages above a thread, one muted Item with a pin each, jumping to the message.

items.name: chat-mention
items.title: Chat mention
items.description: An @mention in a message: a primary-tinted secondary Badge opening the user hover card.

items.name: keyboard-shortcuts
items.title: Keyboard shortcuts
items.description: Optional pattern keyboard-shortcuts: ShortcutsProvider (one document listener, single-key shortcuts off while typing or by user setting), useShortcut, ShortcutHint, the ? help dialog, and lib/shortcut-keys.ts (mod+k definitions, reserved keys).

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command palette
items.description: Optional pattern command-palette: CommandPalette (⌘K dialog with local groups, debounced server search, recent results) and CommandPaletteTrigger for the header.

items.name: grouped-view-tabs
items.title: Grouped view tabs
items.description: Optional pattern grouped-tabs: GroupedViewTabs groups a record's views by question, with counts and severity markers; sub-menu or two-rows variant; one select below sm.

items.name: sidebar-entity-list
items.title: Sidebar entity list
items.description: Optional pattern sidebar-entities: SidebarEntityList (Pinned and Needs attention under a nav item, View all, an optional pin action on every row: star and right-click menu), SidebarEntityFlyout for the icon-only sidebar, PinToggleButton, and the sidebar filter (SidebarFilterProvider, SidebarFilterInput, useSidebarFilter).

items.name: table-density-toggle
items.title: Table density toggle
items.description: Optional pattern table-density: TableDensityToggle (Comfortable / Compact segmented control) and applyTableDensity(); the theme tightens table rows under data-density="compact".

items.name: inbox-list
items.title: Inbox list
items.description: Optional pattern inbox-list: InboxSavedViews (preset filter sets as URL links with counts) and InboxDetailSheet (the item beside the list: summary and actions, what to do, collapsed sections, open full page).

items.name: table-cell-details
items.title: Table cell details
items.description: Optional pattern table-cell-details: TableCellDetails keeps a list-holding table cell on one line (a summary and a ghost button) and opens the full detail in a narrow popover (a bottom drawer on mobile), as a list of names or as bars with visible value labels; lib/table-cell-details.ts scales the bars.
